caption: 01 · SIGNAL — What does the public recognize?. Identify the repeated promise, visual language, subject, and point of view that make the person legible. These signals matter, but they are evidence of recognition—not proof that the work can be produced, governed, or continued.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what does the public recognize? within A Personal Brand Is Not an Institution.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 02 · SYSTEM — What repeats without performance?. Map how research becomes a brief, how decisions are approved, how work is produced, and how quality is reviewed. A system must be inspectable enough to improve and flexible enough to accommodate judgment.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what repeats without performance? within A Personal Brand Is Not an Institution.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 03 · ASSET — What remains under accountable control?. Separate reputation from the name, entity, marks, domains, mailing list, contracts, files, samples, and archive. The public may perceive one identity while ownership and access are fragmented across many records.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what remains under accountable control? within A Personal Brand Is Not an Institution.
rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
caption: 04 · ABSENCE — What happens when the founder is offline?. Run a seventy-two-hour absence test. Can collaborators find current files, communicate with clients, fulfill obligations, protect accounts, and identify who may decide? The gaps reveal where a brand still depends on continuous personal availability.
credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
alt: Diagram mapping what happens when the founder is offline? within A Personal Brand Is Not an Institution.

caption: Institutionalization can turn a living voice into bureaucracy. The aim is not to make the person interchangeable; it is to protect the conditions that let singular judgment remain singular without making exhaustion the operating model.
